title: Contingency Placement Agreements: Payment-Record Concession on Late Charges in an Invoice Payoff
content:
A payment-record concession is taken off the late charges that enter the payoff of a past-due fee invoice of an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements. It applies by the fee payments the client made on the agreement in the 6 months before the payoff: 50 percent for 4 or more payments, 25 percent for 1 to 3 payments, and nothing for none.

| Fee payments made on the agreement in the 6 months before the payoff | Concession on the late charges that enter |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 50 percent |
| 1 to 3 | 25 percent |
| none | nothing |

**Counting.** Every fee payment entry in the agreement's client money history counts, whichever invoice it was applied to, when its date lies in the 6 months before the payoff. A window of a number of months before a date covers the dates after the same day that number of months earlier, up to and including that date; here the window ends on the day of the payoff.

**How it acts.** The concessions that apply are first added into one share, never more than the whole, and the late charges that enter are reduced once by that share; the unpaid amount itself is never reduced. The payoff is the unpaid amount plus the reduced late charges, rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Hypothetical figures

Payoff on 2026-09-30; window from 2026-03-31 through 2026-09-30. Unpaid amount 1650.00 USD; late charges entering 80.40 USD; nothing else applying.

| Fee payments in the window | Concession | Late charges after the concession | Payoff |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 50 percent | 40.20 USD | 1690.20 USD |
| 2 | 25 percent | 60.30 USD | 1710.30 USD |
| 0 | nothing | 80.40 USD | 1730.40 USD |

A fee payment dated 2026-03-30 lies outside the window and is not counted.
